nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: Who shapes what is disposed of as waste?
nodes.answer: What gets disposed of as waste is shaped by monopolistic corporate power, which includes manufacturers, marketers, and giant corporations.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Decent work and economic growth|Sustainable enterprises|Waste management strategies_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How is waste management conducted within your company?
nodes.answer: Waste management in our company involves diligently sorting waste into five recycling categories at our headquarters and stores. We have also stopped purchasing disposable cups and only use biodegradable and non-toxic cleaning products.
